frame: three.js metres, origin at the palace, x east, z south, y up

open.how: a gap grows from the centre: alpha *= smoothstep(g - 8, g + 8, |x|) with g = uOpen * width / 2, and each half slides outward by g * 0.3
open.when: opens over 3 s when a ride comes within 400 m on the gate axis or the arrival scene reaches its shot 3; closes 6 s after it passes

mist.where: a band 200 m wide at the veil foot (y 0 to 40) and at each side fall's foot

rainbow: a faint rainbow arc in the mist in front of the veil by day (not at night)
sound: a soft roar that grows as you approach and hushes while the veil is open
